from PIL import Image; import numpy as np, math
im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_0159.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
px,py,h=0.700,5.900,90.0
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    D=(1.55-z)*256.0/(v-256.0); L=D*(u-256.0)/256.0
    return (round(px+D,3), round(py-L,3), round(D,2))
gb=((B-R)>=4)&(R<200)
print('--- north end scan')
for u in range(0,60,4):
    c=np.where(gb[:,u])[0]; c=c[c>200]
    print(u, (c.min(),c.max()) if len(c) else None)
print('--- base bp (z=0) at v=482')
for u in [40,100,160,220,280,300]: print(u, bp(u,482))
print('--- top edge rows, colours at u=150')
for v in range(298,320): print(v, im[v,150], im[v,290])
print('--- right object')
for u in range(480,512,4):
    col=im[:,u]
    # find non-white non-tan darkish
    m=(col[:,0]<200)&(col[:,0]>60)
    c=np.where(m)[0]; c=c[c>250]
    print(u, (c.min(),c.max()) if len(c) else None, col[380], col[440])
" 2>/dev/null
